name: Necrotic Resurrection
notes: Cast on the body you aim at: takes 3 seconds to complete, 5 seconds for an elite, 10 for a boss. Heresy per raise: normal +1, elite +2, boss +3. At 5 or more Heresy raising is blocked; below that a raise may overshoot 5 (a boss at 4 Heresy makes 7). Sacrificial Penance: while your Divine Favor is at its max (5 to 8 stacks, by Divine Favor's level) the skill changes its name, icon and effect. A 3 second channel on the body you aim at sacrifices it and removes 1-3 Heresy by this skill's level (1/1/2/2/3 is a first pass for 'depending on level'). Summons last until killed or decayed: they lose 1% health every 3 seconds, a boss every 9 seconds. Past the summon cap the oldest dies. Every summon, bosses included, follows you to new floors. Risen summons can't be healed: the Lantern's Holy Light and other ally heals skip them (vanilla PlayerHeal heals any actor on your team, so the build has to exclude them). Boss resurrection must be unlocked through Deeper Depravity. Not free any more: the spec's free level is Divine Favor's instead. Level numbers are a first pass.
summary: Reanimate an intact body left by Call of Heresy as a loyal summon that fights for you. Their health decays slowly over time. Each summon adds Heresy: 1 for a normal enemy, 2 for an elite, 3 for a boss; at 5 Heresy you can no longer raise the dead. At max Divine Favor the skill becomes Sacrificial Penance: channel for 3 seconds to sacrifice an intact body and remove Heresy.
